review.tagline: Self-hosted AI virtual character with voice, VRM/Live2D avatars and game-playing
review.summary: AIRI is an attempt to re-create Neuro-sama as a self-owned digital companion. It runs as a web app, an Electron desktop app (Tamagotchi) and a Capacitor mobile app (Pocket), and drives VRM or Live2D avatars with speech input, multi-provider TTS and an LLM backend. It can chat on Discord and Telegram and play Minecraft and Factorio, and the README describes it as early-stage.
review.audience: Self-hosters and VTuber hobbyists wanting an AI companion with avatar
strengths: Runs in browser, desktop (Electron) and mobile (PWA/Capacitor) from one TypeScript monorepo
Supports 25+ LLM providers including Ollama, vLLM, SGLang, OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini
Controls VRM and Live2D avatars with auto blink, look-at and idle eye movement
Connectors for Discord voice and text, Telegram, Minecraft and Factorio
weaknesses: README states development is at an early stage
Long-term memory (Memory Alaya) and in-browser WebGPU inference are unfinished
Factorio and Helldivers 2 support are WIP or proof of concept
No Docker or compose setup; self-hosting means building with pnpm or using release binaries
needs: Models: OpenAI-compatible APIs, Ollama, vLLM, SGLang, Anthropic
